mapper.insert: INSERT INTO storybooks ( plan_id, member_id, title, thumbnail_path, is_public ) VALUES ( #{planId}, #{memberId}, #{title}, #{thumbnailPath}, CASE WHEN #{isPublic} = true THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END )

INSERT INTO story_pages ( story_id, attraction_id, image_path, content, page_order ) VALUES
( #{storyId}, (SELECT id FROM attractions WHERE content_id = #{page.contentId}), #{page.imagePath}, #{page.content}, #{idx} + 1 )
mapper.update: UPDATE storybooks SET plan_id = #{request.planId}, title = #{request.title}, thumbnail_path = #{request.thumbnailPath}, is_public = CASE WHEN #{request.isPublic} = true THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END WHERE id = #{storyId}
mapper.select: SELECT member_id FROM storybooks WHERE id = #{storyId}

SELECT s.id AS story_id, s.plan_id, s.title, s.member_id, DATE_FORMAT(s.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS created_date, CASE WHEN s.is_public = 'Y' THEN true ELSE false END AS is_public,
sp.id AS page_id, sp.page_order, sp.image_path, sp.content,
a.title AS attraction_title, a.content_id FROM storybooks s LEFT JOIN story_pages sp ON s.id = sp.story_id LEFT JOIN attractions a ON sp.attraction_id = a.id WHERE s.id = #{storyId} ORDER BY sp.page_order ASC
